prs.title: 10400139: credited QHI–Jones relationship with original normalization
prs.body:
## Credited literature relationship
Ohtsuki Problem 7.24 asks for the relationship between the original Borel quantum hyperbolic invariant and the normalized colored Jones evaluation. The literal 2001 definition has, for every nonempty link and odd N>1,

K_N^old(S³,L) = N^(-2N) J_N(L)^N.

The unknot-normalized version N^(2N) K_N^old equals J_N(L)^N. The scalar factor is essential: the original vertex factor is N^(-V), whereas Kashaev’s normalized closed state sum uses N^(2−V).

This is **already_solved, 1/5**, credited to Kashaev, Murakami–Murakami and Baseilhac–Benedetti. The packet supplies a source-convention dictionary, not a new all-link invariant theorem. It explicitly tracks the two tensor orientations, cancelling Clebsch–Gordan face gauges, Nth-root-only phase, later mirror convention, split-link zeros and the distinction from a general QHI with an additional sign ambiguity.

Applies Scheiderer's classical rational quartic to the literal fixed-polynomial question in OWR14/2023 p804. On the three-variable rational unit ball, p=1+f annihilates an explicit rational degree-four moment vector of mass one and belongs to 1+Q_R(g), but has no certificate with rational polynomial square factors at any finite multiplier degree.
